nodes.label: Golden Hour Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Warm cream bg #FDF8EE, gold primary #E8B84B, earthy text #3D2E1F. Single light theme, no dark mode.

nodes.label: Fraunces + Outfit Typography
nodes.rationale: Fraunces (serif warm) for titles, Outfit (geometric warm) for body/UI. Mobile-first 16px base.

nodes.label: Mobile-First Single-Column Layout
nodes.rationale: max-width: 420px centered on desktop, no grids, no sidebars. Single vertical view simplifies development and ensures mobile parity.

nodes.label: Golden Hour Animation System
nodes.rationale: Stagger reveal, subtle transforms, typewriter for diagnostic. Hover gated behind @media (hover:hover). prefers-reduced-motion: all 0ms. No gratuitous motion.

nodes.label: Bottom Navigation Bar
nodes.rationale: 4 tabs fixed bottom, 64px + safe-area. Active indicator: gold dot 4px above icon.

nodes.label: Light Theme Only
nodes.rationale: color-scheme: light only. Simplified dev, single theme maintenance. No dark mode planned.

nodes.label: Web-Mobile Data Sync
nodes.rationale: Same Firebase RTDB shared between web and mobile. No data migration needed. Coexistence: web/ (vanilla reference) + mobile/ (Expo).
